excluded: Original four historical raw checkpoints already in the immutable equilibrium archive
archive.immutability: Exclusive creation, no overwrite, frozen SHA/member identities. Durable filesystem write protection is not asserted.
metadata_selection: All eight producer settings/report/reference/domain/progress JSON files.
Global manifest, registration, and every completed campaign attempt plan/journal/claim/execution/log/result.
Actual root completion, launch, tool observation, adoption and resource metadata with exact bytes and source identities.
Per-member SHA/size inventory, fixed design, path correction, and source/model/external historical provenance.
archive.raw_selection: Exactly the eight current final checkpoint.npz files, including full state/RNG, diagnostics, energies and 200 endpoint observations each.
archive.roundtrip: Actually extract to a fresh directory, verify all member bytes, and rerun complete-parent verification against the eight extracted current checkpoints plus unchanged external historical prerequisites.

child_eligibility_adoption_and_launch: Root-owned and separate from this read-only audit/archive.
complete_verification: Use the frozen source-guarded parent verifier, then rehash exact input bytes. Never invoke a sampler or propagator.
Check every current checkpoint integrity envelope and settings fingerprint; exactly 200 snapshots, 256 beads, expected sweep indices, finite geometry, COM, surface relation and pair/bond domain.
For all four historical chains, compare all 16 non-observation payload dtypes, shapes and bytes; verify reference/domain bytes and permitted report differences.
Match every worker claim, execution, PID, CPU, seed and result to the global manifest; require exactly eight successful journal starts/reaps and a final owned-drain event.
Report every registered sampling flag and its observed metric. No subset or replacement seed, BAR re-estimation or rate calculation.
failure_policy: Missing root exit or global proof blocks numerical assessment. Invalid identities or failed gates stop archive acceptance and retain logs/data without editing them. An ineligible producer requires an explicit complete-failure review; no eligible manifest is fabricated.
readiness_required_before_numerical_data: Root completion observation with actual exit_code 0, exec_session_id 97158, observed_utc, parents_complete_sha256, registration_sha256 and all_workers_drained=true.
The global parents-complete.json has the exact eight-seed order, complete/eligible/drained flags true, no errors, and no unstarted seeds.
Registration, attempt plan and authorization whole-file identities match; independent source review and actual resource receipts are bound.

resource_ceiling.scope: Metadata, checkpoint reloading, hashing, compression and extraction only.
